The predominant approach for supervised KBQA uses the question to construct a logical form, which is then executed to retrieve the answer.

We primarily focus on evaluating the logical form using the Exact Match (EM) metric, which checks whether the predicted logical form is same as the gold logical form... We also evaluate the answers using the F1 score...
